cohort: The study included 233 women with a singleton pregnancy who were diagnosed with COVID-19 infection and delivered in Tuen Mun Hospital between January 1, 2022, and December 31, 2022.
finding: Advanced maternal age, pre-existing comorbidities, abnormal body mass index, active COVID-19 infection at delivery, and no prior COVID-19 vaccination were identified as risk factors for severe COVID-19 disease and adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes.
